source.title: Forebears Lesotho forenames and surnames frequency tables

names.notes: Localized name pool refreshed against public frequency tables. Gender buckets remain sample-level because they are not sourced from an official civil registry.

source.title: ITU Lesotho national numbering plan communication

phones.notes: ITU/LTA source confirms a closed eight-digit national numbering scheme and cellular/mobile allocations represented by the listed leading digits. Generated values are synthetic and are not checked for live assignment or portability.

locations.notes: UPU confirms three-digit postcodes placed to the right of the locality, including Maseru 100. Dataset street/city combinations remain synthetic review samples and are not delivery validated.

national_identity_number.label: National Identity Number

source.title: World Bank Lesotho national identification system case study

national_identity_number.notes: World Bank confirms Lesotho's National ID system and linkage with civil registry/passport services, but no official public number grammar, checksum or semantic digit rule was found. The twelve-digit template is a synthetic placeholder only.

passport.label: Passport
passport.notes: PRADO confirms Lesotho passport document families, but the public entry reviewed does not confirm the visible passport number grammar. The template remains a synthetic placeholder.
